text:
Tom: hey team — Tom here, new on infra. I can ssh into the bastion but when I try to connect to the dev Postgres (dev-rds.internal:5432) it just times out after I connect to corp-vpn. Is there a special route I need?
Sara: welcome! quick q — can you actually reach the bastion from your laptop (ssh ok)?
Tom: yes, ssh ubuntu@bastion.company works fine, I can run `ls` and ping the bastion host.
Jamal: try a raw TCP check first: `nc -vz dev-rds.internal 5432` — paste the output.
Tom: output is:
```
$ nc -vz dev-rds.internal 5432
nc: connectx to dev-rds.internal port 5432 (tcp) failed: Operation timed out
```
Tom: so seems like the bastion can see it but my laptop cannot.
Sara: what OS and VPN client? sometimes macOS split-tunnel rules don't include private subnets.
Tom: MacBook Air M2, macOS 13.6, using corp-vpn (WireGuard-based client).
Jamal: can you share the route table when connected? `netstat -rn` or `ip route` should show if 10.42.0.0/16 (our VPC) is routed over the tunnel.
Tom: here you go:
```
$ netstat -rn
Routing tables
Internet:
Destination        Gateway            Flags   Refs   Use   Netif Expire
default            192.168.1.1        UGSc           8     en0
10.0.0.0/8         192.168.1.1        UGSc           2     en0
169.254            link#4             UCS             0     en0
```
Tom: I don't see any 10.42.0.0/16 route.
Sara: yeah that explains it — our vpn is currently configured to only send some routes. New hires' clients sometimes miss the VPC CIDRs in the split-tunnel whitelist.
Tom: any quick workaround?
Jamal: temporary workaround: port-forward over the bastion: `ssh -L 5433:dev-rds.internal:5432 ubuntu@bastion.company` then psql to localhost:5433. Not ideal long-term but gets you unblocked.
Tom: nice, that worked for now, can connect to psql on 5433. Thanks.
Sara: i'll open a ticket to add the VPC CIDR to the split-tunnel routes for the onboarding group. infra-bot do the thing?
infra-bot: Created INFRA-4821: "add onboarding clients -> include VPC 10.42.0.0/16 in split-tunnel" and assigned to @Sara. SLA: 48h.
Sara: heads-up: security needs to sign off on exposing that route to remote endpoints — i'll run the approval workflow.
Tom: thanks all. also if it's useful, i can drop my laptop model/serial into the ticket.
Jamal: optional: if security prefers, we can enable an SSM jump or temporary port-forwarding service for new hires instead of changing split-tunnel. will propose in the ticket.
Tom: appreciate it — really helpful and welcome to the team 🙂
Sara: welcome again, and ping here if the ticket doesn't move in 2 days.
